group.children: nonempty array of leaf or group nodes

hard_rules: Choose only templates whose automatic_selection flag is true
Apply panel count, reading direction, and temporal relation as hard filters
Return one to three genuinely viable candidates after soft-fit ranking and never pad the shortlist with a weak fallback
Use ordinary grids for regular beats so expressive layouts retain contrast
Apply a dynamic_only template constraint as a hard gate requiring medium or high intensity and non-still motion
Never invent coordinates or alter immutable template geometry
Do not select a topology only because the sentence contains motion
Treat non_slicing routes as high risk and avoid critical dialogue order

templates.name: Single splash
templates.reading_strategy: Hold on one full-page image with no internal navigation.
avoid_when: the meaning needs cause and effect
two reactions must be compared
several concrete actions are required
templates.risk: Low reading-order risk; use only when one image can carry the complete meaning.

templates.name: Equal vertical split
templates.reading_strategy: Read two equal full-height fields from left to right.
avoid_when: one beat is clearly more important
the action travels vertically
templates.risk: Low route risk in LTR use; simultaneity still requires content that does not depend on a hidden causal order.

templates.name: Equal horizontal split
templates.reading_strategy: Read the upper field, then drop into the lower field.
avoid_when: two beats must feel simultaneous
the scene needs a lateral chase
templates.risk: Low route risk; equal geometry must not be described as a dominant-final composition.

templates.name: Diagonal two-way split
templates.reading_strategy: Read left to right across one slanted separating gutter.
avoid_when: the scene is calm and observational
more than two distinct beats are needed
templates.risk: Medium risk: angled borders add energy but do not establish reading order without a clear LTR content handoff.

templates.name: Diagonal setup and dominant payoff
templates.reading_strategy: Read the compact setup, then cross the slanted gutter into the broad dominant payoff.
best_for: directed setup opening into a dominant payoff
conflict resolved by a large final action
one decisive directional change with a dominant endpoint
avoid_when: the scene is calm and observational
more than two distinct beats are needed
the premise must remain dominant
templates.risk: Medium risk: the angled border adds energy, so the small setup must establish an unmistakable LTR handoff into the larger final field.

templates.name: Dominant field and reaction rail
templates.reading_strategy: Absorb the broad main situation, then read the narrow reaction field.
avoid_when: both beats need equal weight
the payoff must dominate at the end
templates.risk: Low route risk; reject when the narrow reaction rail carries the narrative climax.

templates.name: Setup rail and dominant payoff
templates.reading_strategy: Read the narrow setup rail, then release into the broad dominant payoff.
best_for: brief cause followed by a large consequence
setup followed by a dominant reveal
avoid_when: both beats need equal weight
the premise must remain dominant
templates.risk: Low route risk, but the narrow first rail must remain legible before the large final field.

templates.name: Equal vertical triptych
templates.reading_strategy: Read three equal full-height rails from left to right.
avoid_when: one beat deserves much more weight
the narrative is simultaneous rather than sequential
templates.risk: Low route risk; this legacy ID is geometrically identical to vertical-triptych-3-v1.
templates.selection_note: preferred as an asymmetric three-panel option

templates.name: Equal horizontal triptych
templates.reading_strategy: Read three full-width tiers from top to bottom.
avoid_when: faces need tall portrait framing
action flows strongly left to right
templates.risk: Low route risk; simultaneous use should read as three aspects rather than a causal sequence.

templates.name: Three-panel diagonal strip
templates.reading_strategy: Read left to right along two parallel diagonal gutters.
avoid_when: the beats are simultaneous
the scene is quiet
a recent page already used a diagonal strip
templates.risk: Medium risk: the parallel diagonal gutters need explicit adjacent exits and must not be selected from motion wording alone.
templates.selection_note: preferred when three equal horizontal beats are semantically justified

templates.name: Three-way radial Y
templates.reading_strategy: Enter through two upper wedges and resolve below a central Y hub.
best_for: two causes converge on one result
simultaneous actions with one shared payoff
avoid_when: ordinary linear action
the central hub has no semantic role
automatic selection before a redesign passes ratings
templates.risk: High route ambiguity and an adverse user rating; keep quarantined until a redesigned capability test passes.
templates.selection_note: deprioritized because radial geometry weakens stable reading order

templates.name: Two supports into one dominant field
templates.reading_strategy: Read two compact support beats down the left rail, then enter the large right field.
best_for: small actions leading to one held consequence
contrasting source and reaction ending in one decisive detail
avoid_when: all beats have equal weight
the large field is only decorative
templates.risk: Medium-high risk: blockage can override a normal Z path, so rail-first exits and a genuine final payoff are required.
templates.selection_note: preferred when two setup beats feed one dominant field

templates.name: Dominant top with two outcomes
templates.reading_strategy: Read the broad upper situation, then compare the two lower consequences.
avoid_when: the final moment should dominate
the lower beats are not meaningfully paired
templates.risk: Low route risk; the two lower panels must form a meaningful pair.

templates.name: Two causes into dominant bottom
templates.reading_strategy: Read two compact upper beats, then land in the broad lower payoff.
best_for: contrasting cause and reaction ending in one shared detail
avoid_when: the first beat needs to dominate
the two setup beats are not distinct
templates.risk: Low route risk; convergence is valid only when both upper panels resolve into the lower field.

templates.name: Regular two-by-two grid
templates.reading_strategy: Read a conventional Z path across two equal rows.
avoid_when: one beat must dominate
the page needs exceptional urgency
templates.risk: Lowest route risk for LTR pages; equal geometry must preserve equal semantic weight.

templates.name: Staggered two-row grid
templates.reading_strategy: Read a Z path across two rows whose internal dividers are visibly offset.
best_for: route with alternating close and wide shots
avoid_when: only two or three real beats exist
the action needs one continuous diagonal current
templates.risk: Low route risk when row grouping remains stronger than the offset dividers.
templates.selection_note: preferred when one dominant beat needs three supporting views

templates.name: Three-beat rail into dominant field
templates.reading_strategy: Complete the three stacked left panels before entering the full-height right panel.
best_for: reaction ladder beside one held scene
three contextual views beside one dominant contrast
avoid_when: the audience cannot be given an explicit reading path
the large panel is not a genuine payoff
templates.risk: High route sensitivity: the stacked rail must complete before entry into the full-height dominant field.

templates.name: Expanding four-tier stack
templates.reading_strategy: Descend through successively taller horizontal tiers into a held final image.
avoid_when: the ending should feel abrupt
all beats have equal weight
templates.risk: Low route risk; the claimed slowing effect is a design heuristic and needs semantic reinforcement.

templates.name: Contracting four-tier stack
templates.reading_strategy: Descend from a broad opening field through successively tighter slices.
best_for: large event followed by quick reactions
avoid_when: the payoff needs the largest panel
the ending should linger
templates.risk: Low route risk; shrinking tiers must not make the final semantic beat illegible.

templates.name: Four-panel diagonal strip
templates.reading_strategy: Read four narrow fields from left to right along parallel diagonal gutters.
avoid_when: the sentence has fewer than four concrete beats
a recent page already used a diagonal strip
quiet conversation
templates.risk: Medium risk: four narrow fields invite repetition and require four genuinely distinct adjacent beats.

templates.name: Four-way radial cross
templates.reading_strategy: Orbit clockwise from the top field through right and bottom to the left field around a white central hub.
best_for: four simultaneous perspectives around one locus
avoid_when: linear action
the center has no semantic anchor
automatic selection before capability and rating gates pass
templates.risk: High ambiguity: clockwise order is not recoverable from geometry alone and critical dialogue must be avoided.

templates.name: Equal vertical triptych
templates.reading_strategy: Read three equal full-height fields from left to right.
avoid_when: one beat must dominate
the action depends on vertical travel
templates.risk: Low route risk; this immutable canonical ID duplicates the legacy orthogonal-grid-3-v1 geometry and is excluded from automatic selection to avoid false diversity.

templates.name: Four-field horizontal strip
templates.reading_strategy: Read four equal tall fields from left to right.
avoid_when: faces need generous width
one beat deserves a larger field
templates.risk: Low route risk but high repetition risk; vary camera distance without changing semantic order.

templates.name: Four-tier vertical strip
templates.reading_strategy: Read four equal full-width tiers from top to bottom.
avoid_when: portrait framing is essential
one beat must dominate
templates.risk: Low route risk; four shallow tiers can underserve faces and hands.

templates.name: Two supports into one dominant field, RTL
templates.reading_strategy: Read two compact support beats down the right rail, then enter the large left field.
best_for: two clues then reveal in RTL manga
small actions leading to one held consequence
avoid_when: the output is read LTR
all beats have equal weight
the large field is decorative
templates.risk: Medium-high risk: the mirrored geometry is valid only when the renderer and reader both use RTL entry conventions.

templates.name: Three-beat rail into dominant field, RTL
templates.reading_strategy: Complete the three stacked right panels before entering the full-height left panel.
best_for: three clues then revelation in RTL manga
reaction ladder beside one held scene
avoid_when: the output is read LTR
the large field is not a genuine payoff
dialogue order lacks strong eye-flow cues
templates.risk: High route sensitivity: RTL entry, rail grouping, and the final transition into p4 must all be reinforced by content.

templates.name: Two grouped parallel tracks
templates.reading_strategy: Read down the left pair, then down the right pair; the wider central gutter keeps the two tracks grouped.
avoid_when: dialogue depends on alternating row order
the two tracks are not genuinely parallel
templates.risk: Medium risk: a conventional 2x2 Z path competes with track-wise grouping, so critical dialogue order should be avoided.

templates.name: Dominant field with detail inset
templates.reading_strategy: Read the dominant spatial field first, then its contained upper-right detail.
best_for: one scene plus a decisive eye, hand, clue, or object detail
avoid_when: strict chronological order is critical
the inset repeats the parent image
the detail obscures a face or route
templates.risk: High ambiguity: dominant-before-inset preference is not universal, so the detail must refine rather than reverse the meaning.

templates.name: Three-way convergent fan
templates.reading_strategy: Scan three left-to-right fan wedges that converge near a shared lower hub.
best_for: three simultaneous aspects around one locus
avoid_when: strict causal dialogue
ordinary linear action
the shared hub has no semantic role
templates.risk: High ambiguity: fan geometry is an engineering archetype rather than a validated manga reading-order grammar.

templates.name: Slanted unequal supports into dominant bottom
templates.rendering_directive: Preserve exactly three regions: p3 is the full-width dominant bottom panel; the 16px upper gutter between p1 and p2 slants down-left; p1 is visibly smaller than p2. Never straighten that upper divider, equalize p1 and p2, subdivide any region, or add a fourth panel.
templates.reading_strategy: Read a compact context, expand through the slanted upper action, then land in the full-width lower payoff.
best_for: compact context then a visibly weightier action and dominant payoff
cooperative or rescue action whose middle effort deserves more area than its setup
avoid_when: the scene is quiet or still
the two upper support shots have equal semantic weight
the middle shot is only decorative
the first beat should dominate
templates.risk: Medium risk: the unequal slanted supports must express a real s1-to-s2 weight increase rather than decorative motion.

templates.name: Slanted unequal rail into dominant field
templates.rendering_directive: Preserve exactly three regions: p3 is the full-height dominant right panel; the 16px gutter between p1 and p2 in the left rail slants down-right; p1 is visibly shorter than p2. Never straighten that rail divider, equalize p1 and p2, merge any region, or add a fourth panel.
templates.reading_strategy: Read the short baseline and longer mechanism beat down the slanted left rail, then enter the dominant right result.
best_for: compact cause then a weightier transformation and held consequence
small dynamic evidence beats leading into one dominant field
avoid_when: the scene is quiet or still
the rail beats have equal semantic weight
the dominant right field is decorative
a normal Z path is required for dialogue
templates.risk: Medium-high risk: blockage and the slanted rail both redirect reading, so s2 must be meaningfully heavier than s1 and p3 must be the stated payoff.

templates.name: Strong diagonal setup and dominant payoff
templates.rendering_directive: Preserve exactly two regions separated by one 16px diagonal gutter: p1 occupies about one third of the page and p2 occupies about two thirds as the dominant payoff. Never center or straighten the divider, equalize the regions, or add another divider or panel.
templates.reading_strategy: Read the compressed setup, then cross one strong diagonal gutter into the broad stated payoff.
best_for: a compressible setup with an explicitly dominant destination or result
one decisive directional action opening into a much larger payoff
a causal handoff whose endpoint carries the memory anchor
avoid_when: the scene is quiet or still
setup and payoff have comparable weight
the premise must remain dominant
a third evidence view is semantically required
templates.risk: Medium-high risk: strong area imbalance is useful only when the final result is explicitly more important, and the exact two-region topology must survive rendering.
